LESSON: JACOB WRESTLES AN ANGEL

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Bible
Topic 2.5: Jacob Wrestles an Angel
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Jacob Wrestles an Angel, part of The Bible in Grade 6 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: how they apply lessons learnt in their lives • compose and say a prayer to God. Why is it good to pray always?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. in turns, read Genesis 32:22-30 and retell the story,

2. watch a video clip of Jacob wrestling with God,

3. role-play the story of Jacob wrestling with God,

4. brainstorm on the meaning of ‘ persistence in prayer.’

5. discuss lessons learnt from the story,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. in turns, read Genesis 32:22-30 and retell the story,
2. watch a video clip of Jacob wrestling with God,
3. role-play the story of Jacob wrestling with God,
4. brainstorm on the meaning of ‘ persistence in prayer.’
5. discuss lessons learnt from the story,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Jacob Wrestles an Angel together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: the skill of teamwork is enhanced as learners role-play the story of Jacob wrestling with

God.

• Creativity and imagination: the skill of originality is enhanced as learners compose and sing a song on persistence in

prayer.

• Digital literacy: the skill of digital citizenship is enhanced as learners use digital devices to watch a video clip about Jacob

wrestling with God.
